sys_script_include.description: Resolves WHICH x_gegis_ins_policy_uw_trigger_reason row justifies re-opening LOA evaluation or UW Guidelines scoring, given a small context object (consumer + the changed-field list from UWFieldSnapshotDiff + first-ever/renewal/endorsement/manual-correction flags). Depends only on that context shape - no direct GlideRecord reads of extraction/submission_line/loa_evaluation; callers gather the flags from whichever table they own.
sys_script_include.name: UWTriggerReasonResolver
